correctness.rationale: Dirichlet gamma-ratio mixed moments yield exact negative covariance by differentiating P_i^3 and P_i^2P_j at log exponent one, and double derivative gives Var(H). Direct fourth moments give Var(Q). Gamma representation P_i=Y_i/sumY with independent Gamma(a,1) yields the bivariate delta-method CLT; exact covariance limits agree with its gradient covariance. Integral g(x)=x² psi1(x)-x has representation with f(t)=1/(1-e^-t)-1/t strictly increasing, giving rho(a) strictly decreasing. Trigamma Taylor at a=0 gives fixed-m variances proportional to a and -sqrt(3)/(2sqrt(2zeta(3)-pi²/6)); noncommutation follows. Independent closed-moment calculations at (m,a)=(2,1),(3,1/2),(7,3) and mpmath rho tests match. Finite tests do not replace all-m proof.
